item: While the write-ahead log is pinned and the supervisor is sampling, only an explicit list of whole-corpus scans stands aside (503, Retry-After, X-OO-Paused: wal); the briefing rebuild stands aside instead of parking, and /api/briefing carries a paused field
summary: FINDINGS 4c: Home's 15 s poll ran the whole-corpus trending scan 533 times in one bundle while the log was pinned. heavy.PAUSED_WHILE_WAL_PINNED is the one place a compute is added (trending-windows, trending, map-coverage, server-locations, card-audit), each with a one-line reason; a name that is not on it, a prefix of one, or one in another case runs. The pause is the log latch alone (wal_engaged = log_pause_in_force: latch AND supervisor running, because a pause must not outlive its cause), decided and registered in one lock hold so a follower of a running scan shares it and is not paused. Retry-After is the drain's own cadence. The briefing rebuild stands aside, records paused in its state and /api/briefing says so (backend-only: no UI string). Nothing in this tree reads X-OO-Paused yet; the keyword lane's Home back-off will. 57 tests; mutants of every condition of the pause are killed by a named test.
